en.title: Items Sort
en.description:
Sort the values in ascending order of how often each value occurs in the whole array; ties in frequency are broken by ascending value. Equal values keep their original number of occurrences.

The input format, examples and test data were prepared by CSWork; see the statement for the original source and the limits added by this site.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n integers items[i]. This site follows the original constraints: 1≤n≤200000, 1≤items[i]≤1000000.
en.output: Output the n sorted integers on one line, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the rules above; see the companion notes for the approach, the correctness proof and the complexity.
hints: First count the frequency of each value, then sort all elements of the original array by (frequency, value).
